LanguageData.Binguin_StorytellerFrostSpeaker.label: the Frostspeaker
LanguageData.Binguin_StorytellerFrostSpeaker.descript: An ancient presence of the polar ice fields, who writes with frost and speaks in storms, spinning legends for your colony amid the whispers of all things freezing solid - dry jokes. She tells her stories much as Cassandra does: testing you with slowly rising tension, alternating disaster and respite.
